description: ACM Pipeline Observability — Runs, Resources (Prometheus), Traces (Tempo), Logs (Loki), Profiling (Pyroscope)

targets.rawSql:
WITH recent_runs AS (
  SELECT TOP 30
    r.RunID,
    r.EquipID,
    r.HealthStatus AS Status,
    r.ZeroDayStatus,
    r.ZeroDaySurfaceType AS Surface,
    r.ZeroDayChannelCount AS ZDChannels,
    r.ScoreRowCount AS RowsProcessed,
    r.EpisodeCount AS Episodes,
    r.DurationSeconds AS DurationSec,
    LEFT(r.ConfigSignature, 12) AS Config,
    r.StartedAt,
    LEFT(ISNULL(r.ErrorMessage, ''), 80) AS ErrorMessage
  FROM dbo.ACM_Runs r
  WHERE r.StartedAt BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  ORDER BY r.StartedAt DESC
),
log_counts AS (
  SELECT
    rr.RunID,
    SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(rl.Level) IN ('WARN', 'WARNING') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Warns,
    SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(rl.Level) = 'ERROR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Errors
  FROM recent_runs rr
  LEFT JOIN dbo.ACM_RunLogs rl ON rl.RunID = rr.RunID
  GROUP BY rr.RunID
)
SELECT
  eq.EquipCode AS Equipment,
  rr.Status,
  ISNULL(rr.ZeroDayStatus, 'inactive_unknown') AS ZeroDayStatus,
  ISNULL(rr.Surface, 'n/a') AS Surface,
  ISNULL(rr.ZDChannels, 0) AS ZDChannels,
  ISNULL(rr.RowsProcessed, 0) AS RowsProcessed,
  ISNULL(rr.Episodes, 0) AS Episodes,
  ISNULL(lc.Warns, 0) AS Warns,
  ISNULL(lc.Errors, 0) AS Errors,
  ISNULL(rr.DurationSec, 0) AS DurationSec,
  rr.Config,
  CONVERT(varchar(19), rr.StartedAt, 120) AS StartedAt,
  rr.ErrorMessage
FROM recent_runs rr
JOIN dbo.Equipment eq ON eq.EquipID = rr.EquipID
LEFT JOIN log_counts lc ON lc.RunID = rr.RunID
ORDER BY rr.StartedAt DESC

targets.rawSql:
WITH recent_runs AS (
  SELECT TOP 10
    r.RunID,
    r.EquipID,
    r.DurationSeconds,
    r.ScoreRowCount,
    r.HealthStatus,
    r.ZeroDayStatus,
    r.ZeroDayChannelCount AS ZDChannels,
    ROUND(CAST(r.DataQualityScore AS float), 2) AS DataQuality,
    r.StartedAt
  FROM dbo.ACM_Runs r
  WHERE r.CompletedAt IS NOT NULL
    AND r.StartedAt BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  ORDER BY r.StartedAt DESC
),
log_counts AS (
  SELECT
    rr.RunID,
    SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(rl.Level) IN ('WARN', 'WARNING') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Warns,
    SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(rl.Level) = 'ERROR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Errors
  FROM recent_runs rr
  LEFT JOIN dbo.ACM_RunLogs rl ON rl.RunID = rr.RunID
  GROUP BY rr.RunID
)
SELECT
  eq.EquipCode AS Equipment,
  rr.DurationSeconds,
  rr.ScoreRowCount,
  rr.HealthStatus,
  ISNULL(rr.ZeroDayStatus, 'inactive_unknown') AS ZeroDayStatus,
  ISNULL(rr.ZDChannels, 0) AS ZDChannels,
  ISNULL(rr.DataQuality, 0) AS DataQuality,
  ISNULL(lc.Warns, 0) AS Warns,
  ISNULL(lc.Errors, 0) AS Errors,
  CONVERT(varchar(19), rr.StartedAt, 120) AS StartedAt
FROM recent_runs rr
JOIN dbo.Equipment eq ON eq.EquipID = rr.EquipID
LEFT JOIN log_counts lc ON lc.RunID = rr.RunID
ORDER BY rr.StartedAt DESC

targets.rawSql:
SELECT TOP 150
  CONVERT(varchar(19), rl.LoggedAt, 120) AS LoggedAt,
  eq.EquipCode AS Equipment,
  UPPER(rl.Level) AS Level,
  rl.Component,
  LEFT(rl.Message, 180) AS Message
FROM dbo.ACM_RunLogs rl
LEFT JOIN dbo.ACM_Runs r ON r.RunID = rl.RunID
LEFT JOIN dbo.Equipment eq ON eq.EquipID = COALESCE(rl.EquipID, r.EquipID)
WHERE rl.LoggedAt BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
ORDER BY rl.LoggedAt DESC

panels.title: Recent SQL Run Logs
panels.description: Recent SQL-native ACM log tail from ACM_RunLogs, enriched with equipment code.

targets.rawSql:
DECLARE @LatestRun uniqueidentifier = (
  SELECT TOP 1 RunID
  FROM dbo.ACM_Runs
  ORDER BY StartedAt DESC
);
SELECT
  sw.Timestamp AS time,
  v.metric,
  v.value
FROM dbo.ACM_Scores_Wide sw
CROSS APPLY (VALUES
  ('AR1', sw.ar1_z),
  ('PCA_SPE', sw.pca_spe_z),
  ('PCA_T2', sw.pca_t2_z),
  ('MHAL', sw.mhal_z),
  ('IFOREST', sw.iforest_z),
  ('GMM', sw.gmm_z),
  ('CUSUM', sw.cusum_z),
  ('FUSED', sw.fused)
) v(metric, value)
WHERE sw.RunID = @LatestRun
  AND sw.Timestamp BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND v.value IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY sw.Timestamp ASC, v.metric ASC

targets.rawSql:
SELECT TOP 12
  rl.Component,
  COUNT(*) AS LogCount
FROM dbo.ACM_RunLogs rl
WHERE rl.LoggedAt BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
GROUP BY rl.Component
ORDER BY LogCount DESC, rl.Component

targets.rawSql:
SELECT TOP 12
  eq.EquipCode AS Equipment,
  SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(rl.Level) IN ('WARN', 'WARNING') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Warnings,
  SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(rl.Level) = 'ERROR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Errors
FROM dbo.ACM_RunLogs rl
LEFT JOIN dbo.ACM_Runs r ON r.RunID = rl.RunID
LEFT JOIN dbo.Equipment eq ON eq.EquipID = COALESCE(rl.EquipID, r.EquipID)
WHERE rl.LoggedAt BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
GROUP BY eq.EquipCode
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(rl.Level) IN ('WARN', 'WARNING', 'ERROR') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
ORDER BY Errors DESC, Warnings DESC, eq.EquipCode
